correctness.rationale: The only achievable same-color fractions on the ring are 1/3,2/3,1, with symmetric utilities c,c,0. Both partners improve exactly when they begin at monochromatic triple interiors of opposite colors. Marked run lengths give the exact inclusion-exclusion census. Run-boundary accounting and explicit constructions give both welfare extrema. The independent direct-swap standard-library verifier exhaustively matches these claims for n=3..15 (55 population instances; 35,103 distinct configurations). The universal proof does not rely on finite tests.

A 2022 monotone-model cycle theorem is scientifically different, and a 2023 jump-model analysis uses a different deviation rule.
